storyTitle: India's ₹1.2 Lakh Crore Semiconductor Push: Can the Dream Take Silicon?
tierChangeRationale: Semicon India programme outlay (₹76,000 cr) and approved private investment commitments (₹1.26 lakh cr across Micron, Tata-PSMC, CG Power) verified via Cabinet PIB release Feb 2024.
domainFactCheckDetails: Semicon India Programme (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology - MeitY): Government Outlay ₹76,000 crore ($10 billion). Total approved/proposed private project investment commitments: ₹1.2 lakh crore ($15.2 billion), including Micron ATMP Sanand (₹22,516 cr), Tata-PSMC Dholera Fab (₹91,000 cr), and CG Power Renesas ATMP Sanand (₹7,600 cr). Status: Sanand ATMP under construction; Dholera Fab approved.
